Lightwork synthetic kit-packing procedure
Original text by the Lightwork project. Apache-2.0.

A case has five labelled slots on a white workbench. Pack one item per step, in this order:
1. Put the remote control in the slot labelled remote. Check that it lies fully inside that slot.
2. Put the USB cable in the slot labelled cable. Check that no part of the cable crosses the slot border.
3. Put the power adapter in the slot labelled adapter. Check that it lies fully inside that slot.
4. Put the lens cap in the slot labelled cap. Check that the cap is present and the slot contains only one cap.
5. Put the cleaning cloth in the slot labelled cloth. Check that the cloth is inside its slot and no other slot is empty.
If an item is outside its slot, ask the operator to put it back and redo that step. Use short spoken instructions.
